name: Void Seeming
description: Hold a hollow seeming that shows a company of foes a field where nothing stands in the way.

name: Counterfeit Barrage
description: Throw a barrage of counterfeit bolts so dense that the foe cannot find the real ones.

name: Echoing Ward
description: Stand a ward of mirrored images that turns the weight of each blow to the next image.

name: Veil Rending
description: Rend a heavy veil of delusion from a company of allies and clear their eyes at once.

name: Phantasm Tide
description: Send a tide of phantasm across the field that breaks on every foe with the force of real water.

name: Grand Veiling
description: Veil an entire company so thoroughly that the foe sees only open ground where it stands.

name: Delusion Snare
description: Plant a snare of delusion that springs when a foe steps near and seizes his mind.

name: Eidolon Host
description: Call a host of eidolons that sweeps the field and strikes down the unwary.

name: Eidolon Flash
description: Flash from eidolon to eidolon across the field and strike at the end of the chain.

name: Mind Rend
description: Tear at the foe's belief in his own body until the wound he imagines opens in the flesh.

name: Unreal Passage
description: Persuade the world that the user is not there and walk through every guard and wall of qi.

name: Perfect Deception
description: The school's own deception told so perfectly that the foe's mind obeys it and is harmed by it in proportion to the user's reserve.

name: Unmaking Mirage
description: Overwrite the sight of a whole field up to the destructive ceiling of its tier so that all within bleed from a false world.

name: Faint Counterfeit
description: Cast a faint counterfeit of the foe's own ally beside him to draw his strike.

name: Core Phantasm
description: Drive a phantasm charged from the Core through a guard that the foe thought was empty.

name: Sense Cloak
description: Wrap the user in a cloak that dulls every sense that falls upon it.

name: Veil Dispersal
description: Lift a failing sense back into an ally by driving clean qi through the dulled organ.

name: Sense Storm
description: Whip a storm of conflicting sights and sounds through the foes that leaves them blind in the din.

name: Total Veiling
description: Veil the whole company from every sense so that the foe can neither see nor hear nor feel it.

name: Delusion Knot
description: Tie the foe's senses into a knot of delusion from which he cannot find the way out.

name: Phantom Army
description: Raise an army of phantoms from the Core that marches on the foes and strikes as one.

name: Core Eidolon
description: Burst from the Core as an eidolon and strike the foe's heart before the copy fades.

name: Belief Rend
description: Rend the foe's belief in his own senses until the damage he fears is dealt to him in truth.

name: Unseen Absolute
description: Become unseen in every sense so utterly that no guard or ward can find the user to stop him.

name: Sovereign Seeming
description: The school's sovereign seeming that bends the sight of all in range to the user's will for as long as the reserve holds.

name: Sense Collapse
description: Collapse every sense of a multitude up to the ceiling of the Core tier so that sight and sound and touch fail at once.

name: World Unwritten
description: Wipe the true look of the whole field up to the ceiling of the Core tier and write a false one in its place.
